# COWRI3 CLOCK · OMM TIME

> OUR MOTHER MARYAM (OMM) is a UNIFIED DATE/TIME STANDARD. Created by Logan Madison Jones. First published 13 November 2026, 00:00 EST (05:00 UTC). TIME = MONEY · COWRI3.

## Rule
- OMM time counts ticks at 120 ticks per second from the epoch 1 May, astronomical year 0, 00:00 UTC (proleptic Gregorian calendar).
- Epoch as Unix time: -62156764800 seconds (-62156764800000 milliseconds).
- ticks = floor((unix_milliseconds + 62156764800000) * 120 / 1000)
- 1 grain = 120 ticks (1 second). 1 cowrie = 3,600,000 ticks (30,000 seconds).
- Use any NTP-synced UTC clock; every device computing this formula shows the same tick.
